1.explanation:
1. FormField/README.md – shows the container API (padding, border) that may affect child layout.
2. FormField/stories/CustomThemed – demonstrates FormField under the HPE theme, so you can reproduce the exact padding and style.
3. RangeInput/README.md – describes the RangeInput sizing and theming properties (track thickness, margin).
4. RangeInput/stories/CustomThemed – shows how RangeInput is rendered under HPE, replicating the scenario.
5. Form/stories/CustomThemed – illustrates how RangeInput is commonly used within a Form/FormField combo, matching the CodeSandbox.
6. themes/hpe/index.js – contains the theme overrides for FormField and RangeInput (border radii, gap, padding) that likely contribute to the off-center positioning.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided screenshot the RangeInput control placed inside a FormField is visually “bleeding” outside of its container and not centered. The green track and thumb extend right to the edge of the FormField’s border, while on the left the track starts too far in, so the entire slider is shifted off‐center. This happens under both the default Grommet theme and the HPE theme (more obvious in HPE). The misalignment suggests that the FormField’s padding or the RangeInput’s internal track/handle positioning isn’t accounting for the FormField container’s inset properly.
